APPLICATION_URL.description: Application url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

DATABASE_MODE.description: Database mode for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DATABASE_SQLITE.description: Database sqlite for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

TMDB_API_KEY.description: Required TMDB API key from themoviedb.org/settings/api. Movie lookup needs your own key; this template does not supply one.

TMDB_ENABLE_IMAGE_CACHING.description: Tmdb enable image caching for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

TIMEZONE.description: Timezone for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ENABLE_REGISTRATION.description: Enable registration for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

LOG_ENABLE_FILE_LOGGING.description: Log enable file logging for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for movary. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for movary. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for movary. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
